decision: Preserve this as a distinct warm kiln-ash store-skin source, not as the default Foundry skin. It needs the same lossless donor proof and a deterministic runtime grade before any shipping decision.
positiveEvidence: The base-color median luminance rose to 110/255, so the candidate is materially less prone to near-black runtime collapse than the Graphic and Graphite donors.
Meshy honored the explicit body-emission instruction: the downloaded 2048x2048 emission map is effectively black, with no pixel above value 5.
The warm charcoal, brown-graphite, and kiln-ash regions create a visibly different refractory/fortress identity that is worth retaining as a possible store skin.
The task returned standalone lossless 4096x4096 base-color and normal maps plus 2048x2048 metallic, roughness, and emission maps.
limitations: The provider preview still reads more realistic and weathered than the requested clean illustrative game style.
Pure or near-white atlas islands remain: 8.070% of base-color pixels have every channel at or above 225.
The fixed lava-orange region is too restrained for the default Foundry identity: the broad color heuristic finds only 1.119% orange pixels.
The base map includes fine service detail and mottling that may disappear or look noisy at the roughly 41-pixel gameplay footprint.
The metallic map remains stronger than requested, with mean value 136.25/255; production lighting may require an explicit metallic cap.
nextGate: Run nilbots-texture-donor-transplant-4 against the exact GA-003 authority, then compare the donor-exact and a separately recorded stylized runtime derivative in the same production WebGL replay. Do not modify the texture-free semantic team material.
